fields.name: Local authority
fields.description: Name of the local authority responsible for the library service

fields.name: Local authority code
fields.description: Official Government Statistical Service (GSS/ONS) 9-character code for the authority

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Country within the United Kingdom

fields.name: Local authority department
fields.description: Name of the local authority department or directorate responsible for the library service

fields.name: Governance model
fields.description: Overall governance or operating model of the statutory library service

fields.name: Operating organisation
fields.description: Organisation delivering the service if not run directly in-house by the local authority (e.g. public sector mutual, charitable trust, or commissioned leisure contractor)

fields.name: Consortium
fields.description: Shared library consortium or regional technical partnership (e.g. LibrariesWest, The Libraries Consortium, SELMS)

fields.name: Service URL
fields.description: The main public web portal or homepage for the library service

fields.name: Libraries URL
fields.description: Web page or directory listing physical branch libraries, opening hours, and locations

fields.name: Mobile library URL
fields.description: Web page or schedule listing mobile library routes, timetables, and stops

fields.name: Home library service URL
fields.description: Web page providing information on the home library or books-on-wheels delivery service for housebound residents

fields.name: Childrens service URL
fields.description: Web page detailing children's library services, activities, and early literacy programmes

fields.name: Catalogue URL
fields.description: Online public access catalogue (OPAC) homepage or search URL

fields.name: Join online URL
fields.description: Direct URL for members of the public to register or join the library service online

fields.name: Events URL
fields.description: Web page or booking portal listing library events, activities, and workshops

fields.name: Eventbrite ID
fields.description: Eventbrite organiser profile identifier for booking library activities

fields.name: Computer access URL
fields.description: Web page providing information on public computer facilities, booking, and acceptable use

fields.name: Wifi access URL
fields.description: Web page detailing public Wi-Fi access, networks, and usage terms

fields.name: Room booking URL
fields.description: Web page or booking portal for hiring meeting rooms, workspaces, or event venues in libraries

fields.name: Volunteer URL
fields.description: Web page providing information and applications for library volunteering opportunities

fields.name: Fees and charges URL
fields.description: Web page detailing the full schedule of library fees, fines, hire costs, and replacement charges

fields.name: Adult fine
fields.description: Standard overdue fine per day for adult books in GBP (0.00 if fine-free)

fields.name: Child fine
fields.description: Standard overdue fine per day for children's books in GBP (0.00 if fine-free)

fields.name: Fine interval
fields.description: Billing interval for overdue library item fines (e.g. Day, Week)

fields.name: Email address
fields.description: Generic public contact or enquiry email address for the library service

fields.name: Phone number
fields.description: Generic public telephone contact number for the library service

fields.name: App name
fields.description: Public-facing name of the official mobile library app

fields.name: Android app URL
fields.description: Google Play Store download URL for the service's mobile library application

fields.name: iOS app URL
fields.description: Apple App Store download URL for the service's mobile library application

fields.name: Twitter URL
fields.description: Official Twitter / X profile URL for the library service

fields.name: Facebook URL
fields.description: Official Facebook page URL for the library service

fields.name: Instagram URL
fields.description: Official Instagram profile URL for the library service

fields.name: YouTube URL
fields.description: Official YouTube channel URL for the library service

fields.name: Blog URL
fields.description: Official library service blog or online articles URL

fields.name: Podcast URL
fields.description: Official library service podcast or audio broadcasts portal URL

fields.name: Library management system supplier
fields.description: Vendor or commercial supplier of the Library Management System (LMS / ILS)

fields.name: Library management system
fields.description: Name of the Library Management System (LMS / ILS) software in use

fields.name: Online catalogue system
fields.description: Name of the Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) or discovery interface in use

fields.name: Ebook supplier
fields.description: Commercial supplier or platform for digital ebook lending (e.g. Overdrive / Libby, BorrowBox, Bibliotheca)

fields.name: Ebook URL
fields.description: Direct public URL to the service's ebook lending catalogue or platform

fields.name: Audiobook supplier
fields.description: Commercial supplier or platform for digital e-audiobook lending (e.g. BorrowBox, Overdrive / Libby, Ulverscroft)

fields.name: Audiobook URL
fields.description: Direct public URL to the service's e-audiobook lending catalogue or platform

fields.name: Emagazine supplier
fields.description: Commercial supplier or platform for digital e-magazine lending (e.g. PressReader, OverDrive / Libby, BorrowBox)

fields.name: Enewspaper supplier
fields.description: Commercial supplier or platform for digital e-newspaper subscriptions (e.g. PressReader, NewsBank)

fields.name: Online reference subscriptions
fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of major digital reference and subscription resources provided by the service (e.g. 'Ancestry Library Edition; Findmypast; British Newspaper Archive; Theory Test Pro; BFI Replay; Britannica')

fields.name: Green library
fields.description: Whether the library service participates in the Green Libraries Partnership initiative

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: General administrative or operational notes concerning the library service
